def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg,0)}
    color=next(iter(colors))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    pattern={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    ph=max(r for r,c in pattern)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pattern)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
      for c in range(w-pw+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in pattern):
          for dr,dc in pattern: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out

program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marker = next(value for value in counts if value not in (background, 0))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
              if grid[r][c] == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    pattern = {(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points}
    pattern_height = max(r for r, c in pattern) + 1
    pattern_width = max(c for r, c in pattern) + 1
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - pattern_height + 1):
        for c in range(width - pattern_width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in pattern):
                for dr, dc in pattern:
                    result[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return result
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-5c15b574.py'
program_path.write_text(program_text)
# validate through the written task program and demo

assert ns['transform'](A)==B
pred=ns['transform'](T)
